thread:
arjun: FYI the sample-app integration started failing after last typegen regen on main. failing in embeddings call mapping.

taylor: can you paste the failing assertion?

arjun: sure:

```
 FAIL  samples/embeddings.integration.test.ts
   ✕ maps single-string input (15 ms)

   expect(received).toEqual(expected)

   Received: { input: [ 'hello world' ] }
   Expected: { input: 'hello world' }
```

Looks like the generated TS client now converts the solitary string into an array. callers that did client.embeddings('x') now serialize input: ['x'].

molly: that was my worry with the recent oneOf flatten in the OpenAPI — generator is preferring the union-type param. Did regen-bot include a changelog entry?

regen-bot: regen ran for package/sdk-js at 2126004200 1 files changed (typegen).

arjun: no changelog entry. This slipped past regen-diff because file-level diffs are noisy; signature-level change didn't trip our simple hash check.

taylor: options: revert the regen commit, add a compatibility shim in client, or bump minor. For minimal disruption I'd prefer a tiny shim that preserves old positional semantics.

molly: we should treat this as a regression. I vote shim in a patch release + follow-up generator fix so future regens keep the old overload or auto-generate a wrapper. Also add a regen-smoke CI step that runs a handful of common callsites after any typegen change.

arjun: i'll draft a PR with a wrapper that detects typeof arg === 'string' -> {input: arg}. will include unit + integration test.

ci-bot: arjun/regen-fix-embeddings opened PR #518, build queued.

release-captain: if we ship a shim, ensure CHANGELOG.md has a clear note: "fix(sdk): preserve positional embedding param; regen compatibility shim" and roll as patch (0.15.1 -> example). Semver policy: generator-only surface changes should be patched when we maintain runtime compatibility.

taylor: also, small improvement to CI: extend regen-diff job to run `node ./dist/smoke/regendiff-check.js` which imports the freshly generated client and calls a few common patterns (embeddings('x'), chat(messages), completion(prompt)). If any signature mapping changes, fail the job. That'll be fast and catches these ergonomic breaks.

arjun: implemented quick shim in PR and added smoke test artifact. CI shows lint errors on the new helper; fixing now.

ci-bot: build 10045 started for PR #518, lint job failed.

molly: once lint is green merge asap, publish patch, and then we can harden the generator. Also file an issue to add a signature AST comparator during regen that warns on positional->options flips.

arjun: filing issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/719 19 — signature-diff warning for typegen.

taylor: cool. follow-ups: (1) patch and publish; (2) add regen-smoke to CI; (3) consider making generator emit explicit overloads where possible.

molly: thanks all. small ask: ping #devex with PR link if you see any other regressions so we can triage fast.

arjun: will do. thanks :thumbsup:
